title: LOGO_BASE hardcoded to legacy portal URL `https://decades.powerappsportals.com/` — violates loadConfig mandate
detail: Line 25: `const LOGO_BASE = 'https://decades.powerappsportals.com/';` — this points at the LEGACY non-SPA portal, not dmms1/dcfg/holding. Per CLAUDE.md 'Config: dcfg_configs table read at boot via loadConfig() — no hardcoded URLs', every cross-environment URL should be pulled from dcfg_configs.
evidence: CustomerDetail.jsx:25 `const LOGO_BASE = 'https://decades.powerappsportals.com/';`, line 81 img src=LOGO_BASE + filename.
recommendedFix: Short-term: add a `dcfg_sp_logo_base_url` key to dcfg_configs and read via `getEnvVar('dcfg_sp_logo_base_url')` with a fallback to the current hardcoded URL.

title: CustomerDetail hardcodes `isManager={true}` / `isAdmin={true}` to sub-tabs — every user sees admin actions
detail: Lines 130, 132, 134, 135 pass hardcoded `isManager={true}` and `isAdmin={true}` to sub-tabs. Line 32 destructures `isAdmin, isManager` from usePortalUser but those real values are IGNORED in favor of the hardcoded true.
evidence: CustomerDetail.jsx:32 destructures isAdmin, isManager. Lines 130-135 pass `isManager={true}` / `isAdmin={true}` literally.
recommendedFix: Replace the hardcoded prop values with the real function calls: `isManager={isManager()}`, `isAdmin={isAdmin()}`.

title: OverviewTab counts use $count=true but reads value?.length — returns top-page count, not total
detail: Lines 145-149: two apiGet calls with `$count=true` but the callback reads `msaRes?.value?.length` and `locRes?.value?.length` rather than `@odata.count`.
recommendedFix: Either drop `$count=true` or read `msaRes?.['@odata.count']` to use the true total.

title: OverviewTab nested apiGet inside .then has no error handler — unhandled promise rejection on failure
detail: Line 152-153: after the Promise.all resolves, the code makes ANOTHER apiGet inside the .then handler for contracts counts. There's no .catch on that inner promise.
evidence: CustomerDetail.jsx:144-156 — Promise.all with no outer catch, inner apiGet with no catch.
recommendedFix: Add `.catch(() => {})` or explicit error logging to both the outer Promise.all and the inner apiGet.

title: LocationsMapTab injects Leaflet CSS/JS from CDN at runtime — hardcoded unpkg.com URLs
detail: Lines 613, 618: CDN injection. MapView.jsx (line 10-11) imports leaflet as an npm dependency and bundles it.
evidence: CustomerDetail.jsx:613, 618 — CDN injection. MapView.jsx:10-11 — bundled import.
recommendedFix: Replace the CDN injection with `import L from 'leaflet'; import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css';` at the top of CustomerDetail.

title: handleSaveEdit has no try/catch — apiPatch failure is an unhandled promise rejection
detail: Lines 58-68: `handleSaveEdit` calls `apiPatch(...)` then `loadCustomer()` but has no try/catch. If the PATCH fails, the user sees no error feedback.
evidence: CustomerDetail.jsx:58-68 — async function with await apiPatch but no try/catch or .catch.
recommendedFix: Wrap in try/catch. On catch: `toast.show('err', 'Failed to save: ' + e.message)`.

title: LOGO_MAP contains customer names as hardcoded keys — violates no-customer-names-in-production rule
detail: Line 30: `const LOGO_MAP = { 'J-ADD':'jadd.png', 'The Arc Mercer':'thearcmercer', ... }` hardcodes customer names directly in source code. Per feedback_no_customer_or_people_names_in_production.md, no customer names should appear in production code.
evidence: CustomerDetail.jsx:30 — LOGO_MAP with customer names as keys.
recommendedFix: Add a `dcfg_logo_file` column to dcfg_customers, populate it per customer, and read the logo filename from the customer record. Remove the hardcoded LOGO_MAP.

title: MsasTab handleNewMsa has no try/catch — apiPost failure crashes silently
detail: Lines 219-231: handleNewMsa calls apiPost then apiGet to refresh. Neither is wrapped in try/catch. If the POST fails, the panel closes with no error message.
evidence: CustomerDetail.jsx:219-231 — async function with no try/catch.
recommendedFix: Wrap in try/catch. On error: keep the panel open, show the error.

title: OnboardingTab loadOnboarding has empty catch — all errors silently swallowed
detail: Line 382: `} catch {}` — if any of the three apiGet calls fail, the error is silently discarded. The user sees an empty onboarding tab with no indication of failure.
evidence: CustomerDetail.jsx:382 — empty catch block in loadOnboarding.
recommendedFix: Capture the error and set an error state that renders a warn-banner.

title: ProgramsTab loadPrograms has no error handling — apiGet failure is unhandled
detail: Lines 496-498: `const r = await apiGet(...)` with no try/catch. If dcfg_programs is unreachable, the promise rejects unhandled.
recommendedFix: Add try/catch and set an error state rendered as a warn-banner.

title: ProgramsTab handleNewProgram has no try/catch — creation failure is unhandled
detail: Lines 501-510: handleNewProgram calls apiPost then loadPrograms with no error handling. If the POST fails, the panel closes but the error goes unhandled.
evidence: CustomerDetail.jsx:501-510 — async function with no try/catch.
recommendedFix: Wrap in try/catch. On error: keep the panel open and show the error.

title: Customer logo img has empty alt attribute — should describe the image
detail: Line 85: `` — the alt is empty which marks the image as decorative. However, the logo visually conveys the customer brand.
evidence: CustomerDetail.jsx:85 — `alt=''` on the customer logo img.

title: OverviewTab builds dynamic OData filter with OR clauses for every MSA ID — potential URL length explosion
detail: Line 159: builds an OData filter with one OR clause per MSA GUID. A customer with 100 MSAs approaches the Power Pages URL length limit. Same pattern at ContractsTab line 327.
evidence: CustomerDetail.jsx:159-160 — dynamic filter with unbounded OR clauses.
recommendedFix: Add a safety cap: if msaIds.length > 50, only query the first 50 or use a different strategy.
